Customer care

Complaints Policy

Contact Dexter’s

If something has gone wrong with an order, payment, reward, account or service, contact Dexter’s as soon as reasonably possible.

Dexters
10A Dundasvale Court
Glasgow
G4 0JS
Scotland

Email hello@dextersspot.co.uk or call 0141 473 5249.

Information that helps us investigate

Where relevant, provide your name, order/reference number, date/time, the issue, photographs or other evidence and the outcome you are seeking. Do not send full payment-card details or passwords.

How complaints are handled

Dexter’s should acknowledge and investigate complaints fairly, review relevant order and system records, and provide an appropriate response or remedy where one is due. Food-safety or allergen complaints should be treated as urgent and escalated internally.

Privacy complaints

For concerns about personal information, use the same contact details. Customers also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office at ico.org.uk.

Consumer rights

Contacting Dexter’s first does not remove or delay any statutory right or remedy. Customers may use available court, regulatory, card/payment-provider or consumer remedies where applicable.

Scotland

Dexter’s operates in Scotland. These complaint arrangements do not prevent a customer from seeking independent advice, including from Citizens Advice Scotland or an appropriate regulator where relevant.

Last reviewed: 4 September 2026.

Privacy information

Cookie & Local Storage Policy

What the app uses

The Dexter’s website and Loyalty App may use cookies, browser local storage, session storage and similar technologies to keep customers signed in, protect accounts, remember essential preferences, prevent duplicate rewards and operate core app functions.

Strictly necessary technologies

Technologies that are strictly necessary to provide a service requested by the customer, maintain security or complete core app functions may be used without optional marketing consent where permitted by UK law.

Non-essential technologies

Analytics, advertising, profiling or similar non-essential technologies must not be set or accessed until any consent required by UK privacy and electronic communications law has been obtained. Consent must be freely given, specific and informed, and customers must be able to withdraw it as easily as they gave it.

Third parties

Service providers may use technologies necessary to provide authentication, hosting, payment or communications services. Dexter’s should keep an up-to-date record of the technologies actually used, their purposes and retention periods, and update this policy if new non-essential services are introduced.

Your choices

Where optional technologies are used, the app should provide a clear way to accept or reject them before activation and a way to revisit those choices later. Blocking strictly necessary storage in browser settings may prevent sign-in or other core functions from working correctly.

Last reviewed: 4 September 2026. This policy must reflect the technologies actually deployed in the live service.
